_comment: Dates the Constitution fixes, which cannot be derived from the GitHub API. Everything else on the dashboard is read live from the Record. Changing this file is a Record change like any other: branch, pull request, Record Keeper merges.

fixed.label: Constitution expires
fixed.note: Unless re-ratified or replaced by two-thirds of all members. If it lapses, functions revert to the College.

fixed.label: Re-ratification must have entered deliberation
fixed.note: A re-ratification or replacement proposal must have obtained its endorsements and entered its seven-day deliberation period by this date.

fixed.label: Interim role holders' terms end
fixed.note: Unless extended, or until holders are elected. Pull request #2 proposes extending to 2 November — proposed, not adopted.

thresholds.note: Fractions of all members round up (§1). Recompute from members.md if membership changes.
